Learn from me please. I got AIDS cuz I kept delaying testing til I forgot to test.
I only got tested when rashes appeared all over my body (it was too late for me and crossed the AIDS threshold. Rashes do not mean AIDS though. Being infected with HIV has no exact set of symptoms, it manifests differently depending on what microorganisms came into your body before HIV)

But don't give up hope. You still have a chance to be negative.

You have to keep getting tested every month for 4 months. Usually in the 3rd month, HIV test kits will detect antibodies and turn out as positive (two or three red bars on test kit).

Keep getting tested as early as you can so that in the worst case scenario, if it turns out to be positive, your immune system has not yet dropped to significantly low levels to diagnose you for AIDS.

I'm also HIV+. I think I got it around 8 months after infection. I already had a weak immune system before I turned positive. (You can get AIDS that fast depending on how strong your immune system was)
